title: A Yearbook for the Detention
author: Odile Voss
blurb: Felix Ravensworth, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
